payload.goal: Look up member [REDACTED_IDENTIFIER] and read their current savings balance

payload.title: Legacy Member Servicing
payload.visible_text:
Northstar CU - Member Servicing Console
Member Search

Training environment. Use synthetic member identifiers only.

payload.reasoning: The member id comes from the goal rather than the page, so it is parameterized as member_id. Filling the search field is the first step and changes no system of record.

target.rationale: The search field is associated with the visible label 'Member ID', which is the stable, human-meaningful identifier for this input. No accessible name is exposed on the input itself, so the label association is the most durable locator; a CSS/name attribute would be tied to the current legacy markup.

payload.reasoning: The Member ID field is already populated with the parameterized member id. Submitting the search is a read-only lookup that changes no system of record, and it is required to reach the member detail screen where the savings balance can be read.

target.rationale: The submit button is identified by its accessible role and visible name 'Search', which is the stable, human-meaningful identifier for this control and should survive layout or markup changes in future versions of the console.

checkpoint.description: The member detail page displays the 'Savings Account' section, confirming the balance read came from the savings sub-section of a loaded member record rather than an error or empty page.

locator.rationale: A structural section heading that is present for every member with a savings account, independent of which member was looked up or what their balance is. Asserting on the heading rather than the amount keeps the checkpoint valid for future callers.

payload.reasoning: The member detail screen for the searched member is loaded and shows the Savings Account section with the current balance. Reading the value cell via its data-field attribute extracts the balance the caller asked for; this is a pure read and changes nothing. The goal is satisfied once this value is captured.

target.rationale: The page exposes a stable semantic data-field attribute naming the value cell itself, not the 'Current Balance' label beside it. No accessible role or label association is offered for this value, and data-field='savings-balance' is a narrowly scoped, meaning-carrying attribute that should survive layout changes better than positional or class-based selectors.
